interpretation: Encoder-only FP32 reproduces the whole-model FP32 policy regression, localizing that harm to encoder.*. Restoring non-encoder BF16 does not rescue top-1 but does worsen JEPA and WDL validation, so FP32 state outside the encoder may still be useful when isolated from encoder adaptation.

terminal_branches.condition: v2_trunk_fp32_1_12 frozen root legal top-1 >= 0.445078125 and frozen validation comparator passes

terminal_branches.action: run exactly one v2_main_fp32_1_30 Phase-1 arm: FP32 master/state for every non-encoder parameter, parameter precision for all encoder.* parameters, Hero-matched encoder LR ratio 1/30

main_only_arm.question: Can the newly initialized planning and predictive heads learn with FP32 accumulation while the pretrained chess encoder remains behaviorally anchored on its Hero-like BF16 path?

after_main_only_reassessment.if_behavior_is_safe: run paired arena; allocate Phase 2 only if play is not clearly worse and at least one predictive objective improves materially
after_main_only_reassessment.if_behavior_is_not_better: stop precision partition arms and preregister an objective/model intervention, prioritizing reduced root-legality pressure or explicit pretrained-policy preservation
